mapper.sql: id, policy_version AS policyVersion, status, content_hash AS contentHash, created_by AS createdBy, submitted_by AS submittedBy, approved_by AS approvedBy, published_by AS publishedBy, change_reason AS changeReason, submitted_at AS submittedAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, published_at AS publishedAt, archived_at AS archivedAt, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gamification_policy_bundle ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM gamification_policy_bundle WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM gamification_policy_bundle WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gamification_policy_bundle (policy_version, status, content_hash, created_by, change_reason, version) VALUES (#{bundle.policyVersion}, 'DRAFT', #{bundle.contentHash}, #{bundle.createdBy}, #{bundle.changeReason}, 0)

INSERT INTO level_reward_policy (policy_version, level, ticket_amount, ticket_validity_days) SELECT #{target}, level, ticket_amount, ticket_validity_days FROM level_reward_policy WHERE policy_version = #{source}

INSERT INTO quest_definition (policy_version, quest_code, event_type, period_type, target_count, name_key, active, sort_no) SELECT #{target}, quest_code, event_type, period_type, target_count, name_key, active, sort_no FROM quest_definition WHERE policy_version = #{source}

INSERT INTO quest_reward (policy_version, quest_code, campaign_code, reward_type, amount) SELECT #{target}, quest_code, campaign_code, reward_type, amount FROM quest_reward WHERE policy_version = #{source} AND campaign_code = 'DEFAULT'

INSERT INTO realm_catalog (policy_version, realm_code, name_key, min_level, sort_no, active) SELECT #{target}, realm_code, name_key, min_level, sort_no, active FROM realm_catalog WHERE policy_version = #{source}

INSERT INTO gamification_abuse_rule (policy_version, rule_code, metric_name, threshold_value, window_minutes, score, hard_block) SELECT #{target}, rule_code, metric_name, threshold_value, window_minutes, score, hard_block FROM gamification_abuse_rule WHERE policy_version = #{source}
mapper.select: SELECT rule_version AS ruleVersion, level, min_exp AS minExp, title_key AS titleKey, frame_code AS frameCode FROM level_rule WHERE rule_version = #{policyVersion} ORDER BY level

SELECT policy_version AS policyVersion, level, ticket_amount AS ticketAmount, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays FROM level_reward_policy WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} ORDER BY level

SELECT policy_version AS policyVersion, quest_code AS questCode, event_type AS eventType, period_type AS periodType, target_count AS targetCount, name_key AS nameKey, sort_no AS sortNo, active FROM quest_definition WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} ORDER BY sort_no, quest_code

SELECT policy_version AS policyVersion, quest_code AS questCode, campaign_code AS campaignCode, reward_type AS rewardType, amount FROM quest_reward WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} AND campaign_code = 'DEFAULT' ORDER BY quest_code, reward_type

SELECT policy_version AS policyVersion, realm_code AS realmCode, name_key AS nameKey, min_level AS minLevel, sort_no AS sortNo, active FROM realm_catalog WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} ORDER BY sort_no, realm_code

SELECT policy_version AS policyVersion, rule_code AS ruleCode, metric_name AS metricName, threshold_value AS thresholdValue, window_minutes AS windowMinutes, score, hard_block AS hardBlock FROM gamification_abuse_rule WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} ORDER BY rule_code

SELECT id, policy_version AS policyVersion, title, content_text AS contentText, status, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt, version FROM gamification_public_policy WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} LIMIT 1

SELECT canonical.line FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('10|', LPAD(level, 10, '0'), '|', min_exp, '|', title_key, '|', COALESCE(frame_code, '')) AS line, CONCAT('10|', LPAD(level, 10, '0')) AS sort_key FROM level_rule WHERE rule_version = #{policyVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('20|', LPAD(level, 10, '0'), '|', ticket_amount, '|', ticket_validity_days), CONCAT('20|', LPAD(level, 10, '0')) FROM level_reward_policy WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('30|', quest_code, '|', event_type, '|', period_type, '|', target_count, '|', name_key, '|', active, '|', sort_no), CONCAT('30|', quest_code) FROM quest_definition WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('40|', quest_code, '|', campaign_code, '|', reward_type, '|', amount), CONCAT('40|', quest_code, '|', campaign_code, '|', reward_type) FROM quest_reward WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} AND campaign_code = 'DEFAULT' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('50|', realm_code, '|', name_key, '|', min_level, '|', sort_no, '|', active), CONCAT('50|', realm_code) FROM realm_catalog WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('60|', review_score_threshold), '60|policy' FROM gamification_abuse_policy WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('70|', rule_code, '|', metric_name, '|', threshold_value, '|', COALESCE(window_minutes, ''), '|', score, '|', hard_block), CONCAT('70|', rule_code) FROM gamification_abuse_rule WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('80|', title, '|', content_text), '80|public' FROM gamification_public_policy WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} ) canonical ORDER BY canonical.sort_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO level_rule (rule_version, level, min_exp, title_key, frame_code) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{row.level}, #{row.minExp}, #{row.titleKey}, #{row.frameCode}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE min_exp = VALUES(min_exp), title_key = VALUES(title_key), frame_code = VALUES(frame_code)

INSERT INTO level_reward_policy (policy_version, level, ticket_amount, ticket_validity_days) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{row.level}, #{row.ticketAmount}, #{row.ticketValidityDays}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ticket_amount = VALUES(ticket_amount), ticket_validity_days = VALUES(ticket_validity_days)

INSERT INTO quest_definition (policy_version, quest_code, event_type, period_type, target_count, name_key, active, sort_no) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{row.questCode}, #{row.eventType}, #{row.periodType}, #{row.targetCount}, #{row.nameKey}, #{row.active}, #{row.sortNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_type = VALUES(event_type), period_type = VALUES(period_type), target_count = VALUES(target_count), name_key = VALUES(name_key), active = VALUES(active), sort_no = VALUES(sort_no)
INSERT INTO quest_reward (policy_version, quest_code, campaign_code, reward_type, amount) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{questCode}, 'DEFAULT', #{rewardType}, #{amount})

INSERT INTO realm_catalog (policy_version, realm_code, name_key, min_level, sort_no, active) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{row.realmCode}, #{row.nameKey}, #{row.minLevel}, #{row.sortNo}, #{row.active}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name_key = VALUES(name_key), min_level = VALUES(min_level), sort_no = VALUES(sort_no), active = VALUES(active)

INSERT INTO gamification_abuse_policy (policy_version, review_score_threshold) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{reviewScoreThreshold}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE review_score_threshold = VALUES(review_score_threshold)

INSERT INTO gamification_abuse_rule (policy_version, rule_code, metric_name, threshold_value, window_minutes, score, hard_block) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{row.ruleCode}, #{row.metricName}, #{row.thresholdValue}, #{row.windowMinutes}, #{row.score}, #{row.hardBlock}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metric_name = VALUES(metric_name), threshold_value = VALUES(threshold_value), window_minutes = VALUES(window_minutes), score = VALUES(score), hard_block = VALUES(hard_block)

INSERT INTO gamification_public_policy (policy_version, title, content_text, status) VALUES (#{policyVersion}, #{title}, #{contentText}, 'DRAFT') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), content_text = VALUES(content_text)
mapper.update: UPDATE gamification_policy_bundle SET status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL', submitted_by = #{operatorId}, submitted_at = #{at}, change_reason = #{reason}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE gamification_policy_bundle SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by = #{operatorId}, published_at = #{at}, change_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
UPDATE gamification_public_policy SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_by = #{operatorId}, published_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE policy_version = #{policyVersion} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gamification_policy_bundle_audit (policy_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, operator_id, reason, before_hash, after_hash) VALUES (#{policyId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{beforeHash}, #{afterHash})
